caption:
Figure 1: Overview of the BrainIPAgent framework. (1) The Multi-Agent Interpretation Frame-
work extracts structural patterns via collaborative reasoning to generate sparsity masks and textual
priors. (2) The Structure-Aware Functional Encoder maps these patterns to attention biases in
the logit space and projects them via mask propagation. (3) The RL-Guided Alignment Module
dynamically regulates structural guidance strength Alpha (α) and alignment weight Lambda (λ).
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed final full figure and read original caption and eight independent checks. Complete original brain/connectivity and three-panel architecture are retained. New banners repeat the caption: collaborative patterns give sparsity masks/textual priors, functional encoder maps patterns to attention biases, RL regulates alpha structural guidance and lambda alignment. Both clinician/commentator exchanges, pooled prior branches, mask-to-attention, readout and policy reward/update loop remain visible. Full protected source rectangle replayed independently.
